business_context.region: Greater Melbourne (base: Melbourne CBD — Level 5, 398 Lonsdale Street)
business_context.positioning: Career-focused Registered Training Organisation (RTO 46069) + CRICOS provider (04180C) delivering nationally recognised AQF vocational qualifications. DUAL-AUDIENCE: domestic students (flexible online + live Zoom) and international students (on-campus Melbourne CBD). Care-sector-led — Early Childhood Education & Care and Individual Support (ageing/disability) are the flagship verticals by both client priority (Q13) and measured demand. Strategic pivot noted (BDM): was international-only, now open to all Australians (domestic added).
business_context.site_reality: LIVE WordPress site. 9 tpc_course pages across 4 verticals: ECEC x4 (/certificate-in-child-care/, /certificate-iii-in-early-childhood-education-and-care-online-course/, /diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/, /diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-online-course/), Individual Support x1 (/certificate-iii-in-individual-support-ageing-and-disability/), Community Services x1 (/diploma-of-community-services/), Leadership x3 (/diploma-of-leadership/, /advanced-diploma-of-leadership-management/, /graduate-diploma-of-management/). Site splits Domestic (/courses/domestic/) vs International (/courses/international/) via student_type taxonomy. Construction (CPC40120/CPC50220), Cabinet Making (MSF30322), First Aid/CPR (HLTAID009/011/012), White Card (CPCWHS1001) and Child Protection (CHCPRT025) from the questionnaire have NO web page — content gap, not this package.
business_context.ground_truth_sources: Live sitemap (9 tpc_course + 9 static pages + student_type taxonomy) + homepage nav crawl + 27 DataForSEO Google Ads volume probes (Melbourne city-level + suburb-level). No GSC property for tpc.edu.au (fresh — verified absent in connected account). No SE Ranking project (fresh). SOURCE LIMITATION: demand signal is keyword-tool volume + questionnaire + live-site content, NOT the client's own search footprint.

grid.note: Analyst chose KEEP ALL 23 client suburbs at the Phase 2 checkpoint (2026-07-14) rather than trimming to 20. 3 care silos x 23 suburbs = 69 location keywords (9 above the original 60 request — accepted bonus to honor the full Q15 list). Long-tail local play: only 6/23 suburbs have measured demand.

silo_decision_log.summary: Tiers and silos decided EMPIRICALLY from 27 DataForSEO Google Ads volume probes (Melbourne city-level + suburb-level), cross-referenced with client Q13 preferences and live-site content — not assumed.
findings: City-level Melbourne demand ranks: aged care course melbourne 260 (Individual Support) > childcare course(s) melbourne 90 (ECEC) > certificate 3 in individual support melbourne 50 > diploma of community services melbourne 30 > individual support course melbourne 20 > certificate 3 in childcare / diploma ECEC / early childhood course / leadership diplomas 10 each.

'aged care' OUTSEARCHES 'childcare' for courses in Melbourne (260 vs 90) — Individual Support is the biggest head-term vertical, even though the client led Q13 with childcare. Both are clearly co-primary.

Suburb-level course demand is NEGLIGIBLE: 'childcare course {suburb}' and 'aged care course {suburb}' return the 10/mo Google Ads floor (Werribee, Geelong) or NO DATA (Point Cook, Tarneit, Dandenong). VET course search is city-level, not suburb-level.

Leadership/Management diplomas ~10/mo and declining (diploma of leadership melbourne was 50 in Jul-2025, now 10); national/international audience — weak local play. Excluded from the tight 5-slot general budget; covered as on-page content; future international-market package candidate.

Construction, Cabinet Making, First Aid, White Card, Child Protection: no live site page, no Q13 preferences, no demand probed — Tier D, excluded from this package; flagged as future content-gap opportunities.
silo_decision_log.decision: Care-sector focus. GENERAL (5): 2 ECEC + 2 Individual Support + 1 Community Services (analyst-approved 2/2/1, 2026-07-14). LOCATION (60): 3 care silos — childcare (ECEC Cert III), aged care (Individual Support), ECEC diploma — x top 20 client suburbs, honoured as a long-tail local play (analyst-approved 'proceed as requested', 2026-07-14).
